purpose: Compress the complete chronological review of all 4,933 V22 mother-candidate charts into a small causal supply/demand structure. This is a V26-style experiment: freeze observable market structure first, then evaluate whether the structure selects economically useful events. It is not independent confirmation.

source_mother.review_scope: every V22 event in signal-time chronological order

development_governance.validation_open_condition: Only if every calendar year 2014-2020 has more than 50 completed selected events and mean net event return greater than 4.0% under the frozen V22 execution lifecycle.

chart_compression: A short-horizon breakout inside dense six-to-twelve-month overhead inventory is usually repair, not price discovery.
Bull winners commonly make a first passage from an accepted base into a sparsely occupied target corridor.
Broad synchronized demand expansion can overcome old inventory, but a high participation level without recent expansion often marks a mature phase.
Bear-side low-volatility pauses are not enough; stronger cases have already recovered a material fraction of the causal decline before entry.
Missing bars, suspensions, and coordinate discontinuities are not interpreted as chart structure.

common.candidate_identity: exact V22 frozen event_id; no new mother search
common.history_contract: only hard-valid, current-valid, market-rule-valid, corporate-action-valid rows with unchanged invalid_step_cum and available_at <= decision_at
common.execution: reuse exact V22 entry, target, horizon, T+1, costs, suspension, limit, and corporate-action outcomes without modification

bull.inventory_history: 126 completed symbol sessions strictly before signal date
bull.inventory_touch: a prior daily coordinate range intersects the target corridor
bull.low_inventory_passage: valid exact 126-session history and no more than 10 inventory-touch sessions; the count threshold is inherited from the successful V26 clean-corridor representation rather than searched here

causal_demand_expansion.market_breadth20: share of eligible A-share securities with ret20 > 0, computed at the signal-date close
causal_demand_expansion.industry_breadth20: share of eligible members of the signal's PIT causal industry with ret20 > 0, computed at the signal-date close
causal_demand_expansion.renewed_demand: current market breadth20 >= 0.70 and current industry breadth20 >= 0.70 and both breadth measures increased by at least 0.10 versus their exact ten-session lags
causal_demand_expansion.minimum_coverage: market N >= 200 and industry N >= 10 at current and lag dates

bull.economic_meaning: admit either objective first passage through scarce overhead supply or a synchronized new wave of market and industry demand; reject ordinary repair breakouts inside dense supply

bear.decline_reference: maximum coordinate high over the 20 completed symbol sessions strictly before the signal
bear.decline_trough: minimum coordinate low over those same 20 sessions plus the signal session
bear.recovery_fraction: (signal coordinate close - decline trough) / (decline reference - decline trough)
bear.economic_meaning: supply exhaustion must be accompanied by observable demand recovery of a material portion of the completed decline; a pause near the trough is not accepted

primary: pooled mean and median net return
annual selected count and mean net return for 2014-2020
diagnostics: selection counts by bull admission branch

prohibited: 2022-2024 read unless the frozen development gate passes
